name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipe: Cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the onion and garlic.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the sauce over the spaghetti.

name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
recipe: Cook the quinoa and let it cool slightly.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Slice the avocado, carrot and cabbage.
Place the quinoa in a bowl.
Arrange the vegetables and chickpeas on top.
Drizzle with tahini and lemon juice.

name: Chicken Curry
recipe: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add the curry powder and stir well.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with cooked rice.

name: Avocado Toast
recipe: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado in a bowl.
Mix in the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread the avocado mixture over the toast.
Finish with chili flakes.

name: Beef Burger
recipe: Shape the ground beef into a burger patty.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook the patty for about 4 minutes on each side.
Place the cheese on the patty and allow it to melt.
Toast the burger bun.
Assemble with lettuce, tomato, onion and sauce.

name: Vegan Tacos
recipe: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Heat the black beans and corn.
Dice the avocado, tomato and onion.
Fill each tortilla with beans and corn.
Add the vegetables and coriander.
Finish with fresh lime juice.

name: Grilled Salmon
recipe: Season the salmon with salt, pepper and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan.
Cook the salmon for about 4 minutes on each side.
Steam the broccoli until tender.
Squeeze lemon juice over the salmon.
Serve with the broccoli.

name: Mushroom Risotto
recipe: Slice the mushrooms and chop the onion.
Cook the onion, garlic and mushrooms in olive oil.
Add the rice and stir for one minute.
Gradually add the vegetable stock while stirring.
Cook until the rice is creamy and tender.
Stir in nutritional yeast and season to taste.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipe: Season and grill the chicken until fully cooked.
Slice the chicken into strips.
Wash and chop the lettuce.
Place the lettuce in a large bowl.
Add the chicken, croutons and Parmesan.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss.

name: Vegan Lentil Soup
recipe: Chop the carrot, onion and celery.
Cook the vegetables and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils and chopped tomatoes.
Pour in the vegetable stock.
Simmer for about 20 minutes.
Season and serve hot.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
recipe: Preheat the oven to 220°C.
Roll out the pizza dough.
Spread the tomato sauce over the dough.
Add mozzarella and pepperoni.
Sprinkle with oregano.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until golden.

name: Vegan Pasta Primavera
recipe: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Chop all the vegetables.
Heat olive oil and cook the garlic.
Add the vegetables and sauté until tender.
Add the cooked pasta and mix well.
Finish with fresh basil.

name: Chicken Wrap
recipe: Season and cook the chicken until fully cooked.
Cut the chicken into strips.
Warm the tortilla.
Add lettuce, tomato, chicken and cheese.
Drizzle with yogurt sauce.
Fold the tortilla tightly and serve.

name: Falafel Plate
recipe: Bake or fry the falafel until crispy.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and lettuce.
Warm the pita bread.
Spread the hummus on a serving plate.
Add the falafel and vegetables.
Drizzle with tahini and garnish with parsley.

name: Beef Lasagna
recipe: Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Cook the onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer the meat sauce, pasta sheets and béchamel in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake for about 30 minutes.

name: Vegan Vegetable Curry
recipe: Chop the vegetables into small pieces.
Cook the onion in vegetable oil until soft.
Add the curry powder and stir.
Add the vegetables and chickpeas.
Pour in the coconut milk.
Simmer for about 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

name: Pancakes
recipe: Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder.
Add the egg and milk.
Whisk until the batter is smooth.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan.
Cook each pancake for about 2 minutes on each side.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: Vegan Smoothie Bowl
recipe: Place the frozen banana and berries in a blender.
Add the oat milk.
Blend until thick and smooth.
Pour the smoothie into a bowl.
Top with granola and chia seeds.
Decorate with fresh berries.

name: Chicken Ramen
recipe: Cook the chicken until fully cooked and slice it.
Heat the chicken stock in a saucepan.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Cook the noodles in the broth.
Boil the egg separately and cut it in half.
Serve the noodles with chicken, egg, mushrooms and spring onion.

name: Vegan Stir Fry
recipe: Cut the tofu and vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Heat the sesame oil in a wok or frying pan.
Cook the tofu until lightly golden.
Add the garlic and vegetables.
Stir fry for 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, mix well and serve.
